game_title: Flowchart Lab · Find the larger number
game_concept: A action puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Basalt Stair, a basalt column stairway: the forge smith must handle magma slimes while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Unit Trader: Convert units using expressions so each trade of obsidian shards is fair.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Basalt Stair: a basalt column stairway
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Read a and b. Display a when a is greater than b; otherwise display b. Test dataset 9: {'a': 14, 'b': 9}; {'a': -9, 'b': -11}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Unit Trader' (Week 2 slot 14), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Basalt Stair'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Collect 550 points of obsidian shards by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
source_lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 550, or lives reach 0.
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
